text: The accepted Mbox reader and writer suites iterate the same cases with chunk sizes 1, 3 and 4096. The reader compares message counts and each expected message; the writer finishes each message and compares mbox data after normalizing variable From-line timestamps. This tests boundaries independently of message length. Scoped recommendation: retain small-chunk cases when adding parser or writer fixtures; a single large read or a size-only assertion covers less. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
title: Exercise Mbox fixtures across stream chunk sizes
